propositions: Extract the cohesive identity transition call graph (bind, confirm, unbind, reverse cleanup, numeric-ID re-key) from BindingStore into a new BindingLifecycle slice while preserving exact existing behavior and public facade signatures.

Every valid bind/confirm/unbind transition must leave at most one forward and one matching reverse identity entry, verified by reloading both indexes from disk and asserting one-to-one correspondence.
bind_confirm remains last-writer-wins on forward entry and pops exactly the one differing old reverse key without sweep, ambiguity detection, or abort.
Stale reverse entries are removed only in the four permitted cases: bind_confirm rebind, unbind with sweep, re-key, and _retire; all other removals must safety-abort.

Immutable numeric-ID re-key operation moves issues by updating both indexes instead of retiring; note_absent_or_rekey delegated to lifecycle while facade retains guard, no-client/no-id fall-through, and by-id lookup logic.
Legacy records without numeric IDs retain current behavior and all facade method signatures without rewriting.
